content: Stories: none of Circle, Mighty Networks, Skool, Kajabi, Bettermode, Disciple, BuddyBoss document a 24h Stories feature — it is not table stakes in community SaaS. Twitter Fleets (killed Aug 2021) and LinkedIn Stories (killed Sep 2021) failed on platform fit/low usage. Counterpoint for Brazil: WhatsApp Status (900M daily worldwide, strongest in Brazil/India) and Instagram Stories (122M IG users in Brazil) make the format familiar; admin-only broadcast stories ('status do admin') is closer to WhatsApp Status/Broadcast than to Fleets.
